title: Big Data Meets the Turbulent Oil Market
abstract: We use topic modeling to construct novel news-based measures for tracking energy markets. Our parsimonious yet comprehensive set of indicators summarizes the information content of millions of news articles and forecasts oil spot, futures, and energy company stock returns, and changes in oil volatility, production, and inventories. Using an econometrically robust framework to evaluate both in- and out-of-sample predictive performance, we show that our measures are not spanned by existing text and nontext variables. A version of our text-based measures derived from rolling topic models delivers economically meaningful out-of-sample forecasts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用主题建模构建了新颖的基于新闻的指标，用于追踪能源市场。我们简洁而全面的指标体系概括了数百万篇新闻文章的信息内容，并能够预测石油现货、期货和能源公司股票收益，以及石油波动率、产量和库存的变化。利用一个在计量上稳健的框架来评估样本内和样本外的预测表现，我们表明，我们的指标并不被现有的文本和非文本变量所涵盖。基于滚动主题模型得出的文本指标版本，能够提供在经济上有意义的样本外预测。

title: Occupational Exposure to Decarbonization Shocks: Direct and Supply-Chain Measures
Technology and Energy Substitution: A Path toward Climate Change Mitigation
abstract: Mitigating climate change is critically linked to reducing an economy's reliance on fossil energy. This paper examines U.S. energy dependence, measured by its factor share, using a neoclassical framework systematically. We present the degree of substitution between different factors of production as a simple, explicit mechanism for climate change mitigation and for interpreting energy-saving technical change. With timevarying capital equipment-energy substitutability, changes in observed factor quantities alone can account for most of the variations in the income share of energy over 1963-2019. Advancing capital equipment access and quality and integrating the dynamic substitutability between energy and equipment into the design of climate policies can help economies achieve environmental goals.
abstract_zh: 减缓气候变化在关键上与降低经济体对化石能源的依赖直接相关。本文采用新古典框架，系统地考察了以要素份额衡量的美国能源依赖。我们将不同生产要素之间的替代程度作为一种简单而明确的机制，用于减缓气候变化以及解释节能型技术变迁。在资本设备与能源的替代性随时间变化的情况下，仅可观测要素数量的变化，就能解释1963至2019年间能源收入份额变动的大部分。提高资本设备的可获得性和质量，并将能源与设备之间动态的替代性纳入气候政策设计，有助于经济体实现环境目标。
